subject: Recap + proposed runway and milestones for Veridian Health evaluation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Avery Cole <avery.cole@veridianhealth.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + proposed pilot runway (Veridian Health)

Hi Avery & Jordan —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap so we have a shared record and a concrete starting point for a Mutual Action Plan:

Key pain & goals (as we heard):
- High latency and tail p99s on current on-prem NLU pipelines, impacting triage time for case intake.
- Tokenized inference cost is a growing line item; objective is to reduce per-call cost by ~50–60% without sacrificing accuracy.
- Security/compliance: HIPAA controls, audit logs, and customer-managed KMS are required for any pilot.
- Success metric: sub-300ms median latency for 512-token prompts and <=2% accuracy drift vs. current model.

Stakeholders we identified:
- Avery Cole (Product lead) — evaluation owner
- Jordan Mills (Security) — technical sign-off on controls
- Procurement (procurement@veridianhealth.com) — commercial/PO

Proposed pilot scope & runway (high level):
1) Week 0–1: Alignment + scoping call (confirm dataset slices, redaction, and SLOs) — owner: Avery
2) Week 2–3: Private pilot deployment (VPC) + baseline runs and smoke tests — owner: Soojin
3) Week 4: Quantized model run and cost/latency benchmark report — owner: Monica
4) Week 5: Joint review, decision gate (go/no-go) — owners: Avery/Jordan/Procurement

As requested on the call, we will produce a short Mutual Action Plan draft with milestones, owners, and target dates. I’ll circulate that + a POA checklist for your security team tomorrow morning for Jordan to review.

Next steps for this week:
- I’ll send the draft MPA and POA checklist by Tue EOD (attached to this thread).
- Soojin will prepare an initial config recommendation (Dedicated GPU pool vs. Hosted VPC) and list of required infra ports.
- Monica will assemble the benchmark matrix and target test prompts.

Would you confirm the target decision window of the week of Mar 20 for pilot approval? If that works, we’ll align milestone dates to hit that gate.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Cole <avery.cole@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + proposed pilot runway (Veridian Health)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. That matches my notes. A couple quick clarifications:
- The compliance requirement is strict: any test data must stay within our VPC; we will need KMS integration and 90-day audit logs.
- For success metrics, can you also include token-level cost estimates for 100k / 1M monthly usage so we can model TCO?

Week of Mar 20 for a decision gate looks reasonable from Product side. Jordan, does that timing give you enough runway for the security checklist?

Jordan: happy to set a 30-min sync with your team this week to walk the POA checklist once Karthik sends it. Procurement (cc’d) — we’ll need a simple SOW template and an early sense of pricing bands so we can raise internal approval.

Appreciate you moving the MPA/POA — looking forward to the draft.

—Avery
Avery Cole
Director of Product, Clinical Ops
Avery.Cole@veridianhealth.com | 617-555-0123

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed pilot configuration and owner checklist (Veridian)

Karthik / Soojin —

Following up on Karthik’s recap. Notes and recommendations I’ll include in the MPA draft:
- Pilot config: Private deployment (customer VPC) with a small Dedicated pool (2 x A10G or equivalent) for controlled latency testing. Start with int8 quantized weights for cost baseline; fall back to fp16 for accuracy checks.
- Data flow: redaction at ingestion (Veridian) -> S3 staging in VPC -> Redwood inference nodes (no data egress).
- Security controls: KMS key wrap, 90-day audit log retention, explicit service account auth. We should surface any gaps to Jordan early.

Owners and deliverables (with target dates, adjusted to a Mar 20 decision):
- Owner: Soojin Lee — Infra prep & deployment template (target: 2028-03-12)
- Owner: Monica Patel — Benchmark scripts + test prompts (target: 2028-03-14)
- Owner: Karthik Iyer — Commercial MPA + SOW draft, pricing bands (target: 2028-03-07)

Risks to call out in MPA:
- Security sign-off delay (mitigate: early checklist review with Jordan)
- Data access/permitting delays (mitigate: clear ingestion requirements in doc)

I’ll attach the benchmark matrix and a short runbook to the MPA draft.

Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Avery Cole <avery.cole@veridianhealth.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MPA + POA checklist (Veridian Health) — attachments

Avery / Jordan / Procurement team —

Per our commitments, attached are:
- Veridian_MPA_Draft.pdf — concise Mutual Action Plan with milestones, owners, and target dates aimed at a Mar 20 decision gate.
- Veridian_POA_Checklist.xlsx — short security & infra checklist for Jordan’s team to review.

Highlights from the MPA (short):
- Pilot window: 2028-03-13 through 2028-03-26
- Deliverables: infra deployment, baseline benchmarks, cost/latency report, joint review (decision gate week of Mar 20)
- Success criteria: median latency <300ms (512 tokens), cost delta <= +10% vs baseline accuracy, audit/logging present and verified
- Commercial: two pricing bands in the SOW (pilot/scale) and a proposed committed capacity option if you decide to move to Dedicated after pilot.

Jordan — please let us know asap if the POA checklist format works; we can convert to your preferred template. Procurement — happy to have a short call to walk pricing bands; suggested 20-min slot Wed or Thu.

If that aligns, I’ll schedule (a) short POA walkthrough with Jordan and (b) a procurement pricing check-in.

Thanks — attaching now.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
